# OpenLearnHub — Free Coding Tutorials & Curriculum

## Overview

Build a 5-page nonprofit education blog for **OpenLearnHub**, a platform offering free programming tutorials and structured coding certifications. The audience is aspiring and practicing developers, data scientists, and tech learners. The tone should feel **editorial, modern, and minimal** — think clean reading experience with generous whitespace, like a polished tech publication.

## Visual & Style Direction

- **Color palette:** Use a dark navy/charcoal primary (`#0a0a23` or similar) for the header and key UI elements, paired with a warm gold/amber accent for CTAs and highlights. Body backgrounds should be clean white or very light gray.
- **Typography:** A system or sans-serif stack (Inter, system-ui) for body text; slightly bolder weights for headings. Article cards should prioritize readability with clear hierarchy — tag → title → author/date.
- **Layout:** Card-based grid for articles (2–3 columns on desktop, single column on mobile). The learn page should feel structured and organized, almost like a syllabus. The donate page should feel warm and mission-driven.

## Key Priorities

1. **Article grid on the home page** is the centerpiece — each card needs a thumbnail, colored tag label, title, author avatar, author name, and relative timestamp. The "Load More" button should dynamically append additional cards.
2. **Donation page interactions** are critical: the amount selector tabs ($5/$10/$20/$40) must visually highlight the active selection and update descriptive text. The FAQ accordion must toggle open/close smoothly.
3. **Tag pages** (AI and Web Scraping) should display the tag name with post count, a horizontal row of popular tags with their counts, and filtered article grids.
4. **Mobile hamburger menu** must work on all pages, expanding to reveal Forum, Curriculum, and Donate links.
5. **Cross-page navigation** must be consistent and functional — all header links should route correctly between pages.

Refer to `task_input.json` for exact section structures, data content, and interaction specifications.

---

## Data Sources

1. Read `/app/benchmark/source_brief.md` for all content materials (text, data).
2. Read `/app/benchmark/task_input.json` for structural requirements, data placement, and interaction definitions.

## Output Requirements

1. Output all files to `/app/output/`. `index.html` must be the main entry point.
2. All pages must be openable directly in a browser (no build step needed). Use relative paths for inter-page links.

## Automated Execution Rules

There is no human operator online for this session. Follow these rules:

1. **Skip all confirmation/approval/user-input steps** — make professional judgments autonomously. Do not pause, ask questions, or wait for replies.
2. **Design decisions** — if `task_input.json` specifies `site.tone`, `site.audience`, etc., use them to choose styles, layouts, and color schemes. Otherwise, make professional judgments.
3. **Priority** — these rules override any interactive-wait instructions in SKILL.md. The skill's workflow, quality standards, and technical specs remain fully effective — only skip interactive waits.

# OpenLearnHub — Free Coding Tutorials & Curriculum

## Brand
OpenLearnHub is a nonprofit education platform offering free programming tutorials, certifications, and a structured coding curriculum. The platform serves aspiring and practicing software developers, data scientists, and tech learners through expert-written articles, interactive courses, and community-driven resources.

Brand colors: #0A0A23 (primary dark navy), #FEAC32 (accent gold/yellow), #002EAD (link blue)

Tone: Editorial, modern, minimal. Clean card-based layouts with generous whitespace.

- Search bar placeholder: "Search 12,000+ tutorials, articles, and books"
- Navigation links: Forum | Curriculum | Donate
- Mobile: Hamburger menu toggle expands to show Forum, Curriculum, and Donate links
- Banner below header: "Learn to code — free 3,000-hour curriculum"

## Hero Banner
Text: "Learn to code — free 3,000-hour curriculum"
Context: Persistent banner across all news/tag pages linking to the curriculum.

## Donation Hero
Title: "Help Our Charity Do More"
Body: "OpenLearnHub is a highly efficient education charity. When you donate, you help people learn new skills and provide for their families. You also help us create new resources for you to use to expand your own technology skills."

Donation amount selector tabs: **$5** | **$10** | **$20** (default) | **$40**
Dynamic text: "Your $20 donation will provide 1,000 hours of learning to people around the world each month."
CTA button: "Donate"
Sub-label: "Donating $20 / month: edit amount · Secure donation"

## Supporter Benefits
- No more donation prompt popups
- You'll get a Supporter badge
- Your profile image will get a golden halo around it
- You'll gain access to special Supporter Discord channels — join our Discord and use the /supporter command
- And more benefits to come soon

## Current Initiatives
- Creating new JavaScript and Python curricula
- Creating English and math curricula
- Translating our curriculum and tutorials into 32 languages
- Creating a free accredited computer science bachelor's degree

- Published 193 full-length courses on YouTube

OpenLearnHub is a highly efficient education charity. When you donate, you help people learn new skills and provide for their families. You also help us create new resources for you to use to expand your own technology skills.

Donate

Donating $20 / month: edit amount · Secure donation

Supporter Benefits

  • No more donation prompt popups
  • You'll get a Supporter badge
  • Your profile image will get a golden halo around it
  • You'll gain access to special Supporter Discord channels — join our Discord and use the /supporter command
  • And more benefits to come soon

  • Creating new JavaScript and Python curricula
  • Creating English and math curricula
  • Translating our curriculum and tutorials into 32 languages
  • Creating a free accredited computer science bachelor's degree

193 full-length courses on YouTube

5 free books through OpenLearnHub Press

1.5M words translated for accessibility

You can reach our donor support team at donors@openlearnhub.org. We typically respond within one business day. You can also visit our donor help center for answers to common questions about receipts, account management, and payment methods.
OpenLearnHub is a fully transparent 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization. We publish annual financial reports, and our IRS Form 990 is publicly available on our website. Every donation is tracked, and we provide detailed breakdowns of how funds are allocated across programs, curriculum development, server costs, and operations.
OpenLearnHub is one of the most efficient education charities worldwide. Over 90% of every dollar goes directly toward creating free educational resources, curriculum development, and running our learning platform. This means your donation has maximum impact on learners around the world.
You can make a one-time donation by selecting any amount on our donation page and choosing the one-time option at checkout. All major credit cards, debit cards, and PayPal are accepted. You'll receive an immediate email receipt for your tax records.
Yes, we accept cryptocurrency donations including Bitcoin (BTC), Ethereum (ETH), USD Coin (USDC), and several other major cryptocurrencies through our crypto donation portal. Crypto donations may provide tax benefits since they are treated as property donations.
Yes, checks can be mailed to our office: OpenLearnHub, 548 Market St, PMB 12345, San Francisco, CA 94104-5401. Please make checks payable to "OpenLearnHub" and include your email address for your donation receipt.
Many employers offer matching gift programs that can double or triple your donation. Check with your HR department or use our matching gift search tool. For payroll deductions, contact donors@openlearnhub.org and we'll provide your employer with the necessary setup instructions.
To discuss endowment giving options, please contact our major gifts team at major-gifts@openlearnhub.org. We can work with you and your financial advisor to structure an endowed gift that creates lasting impact and aligns with your philanthropic goals for generations of learners.
Legacy gifts can be arranged through your estate planning. Contact legacy@openlearnhub.org to discuss including OpenLearnHub in your will, trust, or as a beneficiary designation on retirement accounts or life insurance policies.
Stock donations can be made through our brokerage account. Contact stock-donations@openlearnhub.org for our DTC transfer instructions, brokerage account details, and the necessary forms. Donating appreciated securities may provide significant tax advantages.
You can manage your recurring donations through your donor dashboard at openlearnhub.org/account/donations. From there you can update your payment method, change the donation amount, pause, or cancel your monthly donation at any time. You can also email donors@openlearnhub.org for assistance.
Visit our full Donor FAQ at openlearnhub.org/donate/faq for additional information about workplace giving, donor-advised funds (DAFs), vehicle donations, and other ways to support our mission. You can also subscribe to our donor newsletter for updates on the impact of your giving.
